395:t_4:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
(This might be... my chance...!)

395:t_4:26.en:
$$ティファ$$
(This feeling... Who are you...?)

395:t_2:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's been so long that I was worried I wouldn't be able to dance properly... How was it, $$レド$$?」

395:t_2:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank you. Looks like my body remembered after all.」

395:t_2:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to see $$エイミー$$ dance.」

395:t_2:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Okay...! Then I'll dance for you, $$レド$$.」

395:t_2:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Enemy signature confirmed. Interception required.」

395:t_2:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Unique reaction analysis complete. Probability 99.97%...」

395:t_2:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Target identified as $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

395:t_3:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

395:t_3:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「He went with Captain $$ジェフリー$$ to the Fleet Commander to explain the situation.」

395:t_3:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Admittedly, if the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really had come to Earth, that would be a mess.」

395:t_3:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「However, the creature Ensign $$レド$$ killed is what the fleet calls a $$クジライカ$$, and it existed before the transfer.」

395:t_3:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「So the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ were already in the $$残されの海$$ before it was transferred to $$翠の地球$$, huh.」

395:t_3:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It can also be inferred that the $$人類銀河同盟$$ that Ensign $$レド$$ belonged to and the $$残されの海$$ are the same world.」

395:t_3:10.en:
$n
「So those two were thrown to the galactic center and the galactic frontier, respectively...」

395:t_3:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「An operation to find the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ nest and wipe them out...」

395:t_3:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But hey, to the fleet folks, those $$クジライカ$$s are like messengers of the gods.」

395:t_3:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Besides, they're supposedly safe creatures as long as we don't make the first move.」

395:t_3:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And going out of our way to exterminate them, after all...」

395:t_3:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「But Chamber's analysis says it's certain that the $$クジライカ$$ is a kind of $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

395:t_3:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「We got a more-than-enough taste of how terrifying those things are when we were thrown to the galactic center.」

395:t_3:18.en:
$n
「Strike before they strike you... $$レド$$'s proposal has some merit...」

395:t_3:20.en:
$n
「I figured you'd say that, you being you.」

395:t_3:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then try communicating with them through your song. If you can't, they get classified as $$バアル$$.」

395:t_3:24.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Of course. If someone just decides they're $$バアル$$ or whatever, they wouldn't stand for it either.」

395:t_3:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you think those things have hearts and wills of their own?」

395:t_3:26.en:
$$バサラ$$
「How can I reach a conclusion without even trying?」

395:t_3:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we may not be able to afford waiting for that. The $$サイデリアル$$' activity in the $$残されの海$$ is probably a survey of the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

395:t_3:28.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They're fighting $$バアル$$ too, after all.」

395:t_3:29.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then I'll make them hear my song before that.」

395:t_3:32.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「This is also a matter of $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet culture. As long as the $$クジライカ$$ doesn't come after us, we have no authority to decide.」

395:t_3:33.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I agree with Captain $$ガムリン$$ too. Let's hear the fleet people's opinions first.」

395:t_3:34.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I wonder what kind of talk $$レド$$ is having right about now...」

395:t_3:38.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

395:t_3:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Then, if you'll excuse us.」

395:t_3:41.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...Does everyone understand the situation?」

395:t_3:42.en:
$$リジット$$
「How could they... We warned them so strongly not to lay a hand on the $$クジライカ$$...」

395:t_3:43.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Unrest has already begun to spread among the residents.」

395:t_3:44.en:
$$クラウン$$
「Rumors are even going around that a curse will strike.」

395:t_3:45.en:
$$リジット$$
「We can't dismiss it with the word 'superstition'.」

395:t_3:46.en:
$$クラウン$$
「Sailors hold such things dear. With that greatest of taboos broken, it's only a natural reaction.」

395:t_3:47.en:
$$オルダム$$
「But as Captain $$ジェフリー$$ also reported, we must not forget that the $$クジライカ$$ are the same as what $$レド$$ calls the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

395:t_3:48.en:
$$リジット$$
「So you're saying we should condone what he did?」

395:t_3:49.en:
$$オルダム$$
「That is not what I mean. What matters is not blaming what has already happened, but discussing what to do from here.」

395:t_3:51.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Speaking of which, Fleet Commander... I'd like to hear your answer to my proposal from the other day, now that we have the chance.」

395:t_3:53.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I request permission to separate my fleet from $$ガルガンティア$$ and act independently.」

395:t_3:54.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Do you intend to go over to the $$サイデリアル$$?」

395:t_3:55.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I am not that foolish. That is precisely why I intend to obtain enough power to stand against them.」

395:t_3:56.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I am going to the $$霧の海$$.」

395:t_3:57.en:
$$リジット$$
「If a great shipowner like you leaves now, the fleet's defenses will plummet...!」

395:t_3:58.en:
$$フランジ$$
「This is a decision reached after long deliberation. I hope you won't think ill of me.」

395:t_3:60.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I won't... allow it. Endangering all of $$ガルガンティア$$ for the selfish gain of a few... must ne...ver...」

395:t_3:63.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Oh no...! It's one of his attacks!」
